svg.title: RaceDay Entity Relationship Diagram
svg.desc: Seven SQL Server tables with exact column names, datatypes, nullability, keys and UML multiplicities.
svg.text: UQ2* (EventId, BibNumber) WHERE BibNumber IS NOT NULL
Completed: finish time must be present and positive.
Other outcomes: finish time is NULL.
PK = primary key FK = foreign key UQ = single-column unique key UQ1/UQ2 = composite keys shown in the table
UQ* = filtered unique index 1 = exactly one 0..* = zero or many 0..1 = zero or one
All foreign keys use ON DELETE NO ACTION and ON UPDATE NO ACTION. Names, types and NULL rules match RaceDay.sql.
Source: RaceDay.sql and RaceDay-Data-Dictionary.md. UML notation follows the lecturer's Part 1 feedback.
